title: Tenma Tsukasa — Souvenir Excitement〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: The day before the trip
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... This is the day, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's finally come!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Today, we're going to buy the absolutely most essential items for our trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: None other than! Snacks for the train ride over!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hooray♪ Alright, what should we get?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Actually, Tsukasa!
What's our budget situation?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Budget...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're high schoolers, Saki.
Do you know what that means?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When we were little, our limit was 300 yen per person. But now that we're older, we can add a few zeroes to that, can we not?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Money is no object!
Let's buy as much as we can eat on this trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...! Like a grown-up vacation...?!
Snack Aisle

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's first grab all the usual chocolates, candy and other snacks from this aisle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll need a mix of sweet and salty snacks since our mood will change as time goes on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, these animal-shaped cookies are so cute! I bet Shiho would love these!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, here are all the potato chips.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
We can't get the party started without these♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, they even have seasonal flavors!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I remember us shopping like this when we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki and I went to the store to buy snacks...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh, sorry.
I was remembering how we went shopping like this when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When we were little...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember!
When we were in elementary school, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You came along to help me pick our snacks to take on that one field trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you remember that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course I remember!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You helped me find snacks that were cheap, but had enough to share with my friends. That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how I couldn't go on many field trips, because I kept getting sick all the time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was really worried that I'd catch a cold or something after you helped me find those snacks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you told me not to worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Pegasusman is here to protect you.”
“I will defend you against any nasty bugs!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That made me feel a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! And Pegasusman kept his promise, did he not?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! You singing with me while we washed our hands and stuff probably worked, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still remember the smile on Saki's face as she waved her hand when she left for that field trip.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Her weak constitution prevented her from going on many field trips at all...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But now she's well enough that we even get to go on a trip together.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Furthermore, due to our busy performance schedules, we haven't been able to spend time like this lately.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which is why my goal will be to treasure every second of this trip.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, Tsukasa, what else should we get?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes! Based on this aisle's selection...
